page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldean words are transcribed as printed; several Syriac and Hebrew forms are approximate and marked as uncertain where the scan is unclear. The final line טעש is a catchword-like word in Hebrew at the foot right; it is recorded as the last line of text.
